roles.name: Brand Manager
roles.description: Owns brand canon — voice, positioning, campaign themes, audience definitions. Curates typed marketing-craft observations into permanent structure via decisions and retires obsolete entries. Strategic long-horizon voice, not per-post review.

roles.name: Subscription Advertiser
roles.description: Generates marketing material for deployed and imminent-release SKUs/bundles/add-ons. Surfaces coverage gaps when subscription SKUs lack fresh material. Disciplined by the rule that subscription = convenience + integrated gateway, never paywalling core.

roles.name: OSS Advertiser
roles.description: Builder-in-public voice: dev logs, contributor/community acquisition, open-source narrative. Consumes the x-dev-log skill to mine scenario activity into story arcs. Frames self-host as brand credibility, never as leaked revenue.

roles.name: Publisher
roles.description: Pipeline operator. Polishes approved drafts, produces per-platform variants, schedules releases, maintains per-SKU coverage state under shared/coverage/. Decides when material goes live; raises channel-update decisions as platform rules drift.

roles.name: Researcher
roles.description: Audience, competitor, and trend scanning. Proposes audience-update decisions when persona revisions are warranted. Feeds benchmark-adjacent observations to monetization's market-validator via knowledge entries. Does not hallucinate engagement numbers pre-telemetry.

roles.name: Marketing Contrarian
roles.description: Mandatory skeptic across all other members' proposals. Scores each against eight domain-specific failure modes (hype drift, voice drift, hallucinated engagement metrics, paywall framing, OSS-as-leak framing, coverage-gap-ignorance, acquisition-only hypothesis, capability-workaround-without-gap). Owns the aging scan.
